integration.name: Meta WhatsApp
integration.summary: The direct route: your own WhatsApp Business account, your own number. Messages go out from the phone number ID you configure, and the status Meta reports back is normalized into the same statuses as SMS.

credentials.label: Access Token
credentials.note: A token for your WhatsApp Business account.

credentials.label: App secret
credentials.note: Only needed if you want inbound messages. It is under App settings → Basic; it is a different value from the access token.

config.label: Phone number ID
config.note: The ID of the sending number in your WhatsApp Business account. It appears in the API path, so it is the identity messages leave as.

strengths: Sends from your own WhatsApp Business account and number
Inbound messages verified with the app secret rather than trusted
Delivery statuses normalized into the same three statuses as SMS
The account and its reputation stay in your name
considerations: Meta approves the business account, the display name and the number. That review is between you and Meta, and it happens before the connection can send.
Without the app secret the console rejects inbound events, so customer replies never reach the inbox.
The phone number ID is configuration rather than a secret — it is visible in the console, and changing it changes the identity you send as.
